_comment: Copy to content/targets.json and fill in. targets.json is gitignored.
One entry per ACCOUNT per PLATFORM. `profile` is the aggregator profile name you
created when you connected that account.
draft=true uploads to the app's inbox/drafts so you can add trending audio by hand
before publishing. This is the default and it is deliberate: video published
through ANY social API cannot use the platform's licensed music library.
Two accounts on the SAME platform are auto-staggered (--stagger, default 25 min).
Posting the identical clip to several accounts at once is the pattern that trips
spam detection -- vary the caption too, that is what the per-target `caption` is for.

targets.caption: Stormcaller vs Cryomancer. Every spell is dodgeable.
